en-US.title: Ticketiv Access
en-US.shortDescription: Ticket scanning and check-in for authorized Ticketiv event staff.
en-US.fullDescription:
Ticketiv Access helps authorized event staff check in guests at Ticketiv events. This is the staff app; attendees should use Ticketiv to discover events and access their tickets.

Sign in as event staff, pair your device and select your assigned event. Use the camera to scan ticket QR codes and see the validation result, duplicate-entry warnings and check-in totals for your device.

Prepare your event manifest while connected before working offline. Offline scans are stored on the device and synchronized when connectivity returns. Keep devices synchronized during an event so staff can work with current check-in information.

An authorized staff account and an event assignment are required. Camera permission is used for QR scanning. Contact your event organizer for access or support@ticketiv.app for assistance.
